name: risor-structural-patterns-across-runtime-objects
instr:
Risor cannot yet structurally match nested objects and lists, bind values for guarded arms, or capture list remainders. Implement this through each runtime value's established attributes without exposing unsupported internals, and keep parsing, execution, persistence, and bytecode inspection reliable.

`MatchBindings`, `MatchResult`, `MatchError`, `Match`, `Pattern`, and `PatternKind` are public from `github.com/deepnoodle-ai/risor/v2/pkg/object`. Matching must deterministically distinguish complete success, clean mismatch, and error, returning bindings only on complete success. `Pattern` exposes `Kind() PatternKind`. Nested patterns recursively enforce shape, required members, literal leaves, exact list length, and an optional final ordered rest capture.

Object extraction must honor the distinct established attribute behavior of String, Error, Time, and Builtin. An unavailable attribute mismatches; a resolver failure is an error. The same object-pattern syntax must observe only those established attributes. A missing structured Error attribute must select a later arm without retaining tentative outer bindings.

Reject malformed structures, misplaced rests, and duplicate bindings. Rendering must reparse to the same hierarchy, and every node must span its complete source text. Walking must visit nested patterns and bindings exactly once in stable preorder, which also determines compiler binding slots.

Arm bindings exist only while evaluating that arm's guard and result. Fail
